_about: The 5 most-used questions per role for the SupplyChain Insight AI POC. One source for: Flowise conversation starters (flowise/scinsight/deploy.py), LangGraph Studio inputs (scripts/langgraph_assistants.py) and the Flowise-vs-LangGraph test set (scripts/scinsight_compare.py). 'intent' = the specialist the SC Agent Manager should route to (a list when two are equally right); 'expect' = facts checked on the calculation the answer cites (path = value), never on the wording.
